name: Same product, new audience (re-target a proven body to a new tribe or use-case)
status: STRATEGY FORMAT. Proven externally on one product category (heated robes: 834K, 509K, 417K, 1.3M ×2). Internally, the same robe body carried 4 different recipients to 165K-6.6M. The cheapest format: 1 new generation per video.
summary: Keep a proven body's generations and replace only the hook generation and text with a new tribe or use-case ('period cramps', 'BTS army', 'Goths', 'grandma', 'nurses'). New first frames make it a new video to Meta's similarity matcher, at a quarter of the credit cost.
why: warmrobestore 'Period girls RUN don't walk to Target 🩸🙃' 834K / 29K shares: the same robe sold as cramp relief (X).
obsidianrobes '“Just wear slippers”🙄' 509K; thecozybts 417K; goth.robes 1.3M; nocturne.robes0 1.3M: one product category, five tribes (external REPORT §4 #2).
Internal: one robe body under women (6.6M), mom (2.7M), grandma (183K) and wife (165K) recipients.

HISTORICAL ONLY - footage reuse is BANNED (D180/D192), every video is fully unique. Old observation: gen c0ede3c3 sits in both the 1.4M Walmart and the 1.4M Target reels, and 13 generations were reused across 2-3 reels (PLAYBOOK §15.6). Only identical FILES collapse (6.6M → 2.2K).

generations.title: Tribe-signalling hook
generations.inputs: <<<video_1>>> = the source winner's own hook clip; <<<image_1>>> = cast image of the tribe
generations.basis: T3 background/cast-only swap (88K; gens 8463df4d, 633c0bb6, 00384ba0). The person swap is the one change.
generations.prompt:
Recreate <<<video_1>>> 1:1 perfectly. Do not change the camera angle and movements. There are only 2 changes you are going to make.
Change 1: Replace the woman in <<<video_1>>> with the woman in <<<image_1>>> ({tribe styling}); the {product} stays exactly the same.
Change 2: Remove the caption from <<<video_1>>>.
Other than change 1 and change 2, replicate <<<video_1>>> 1:1 perfectly.
Add a small American flag somewhere in the background.

shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.

rules: Person swaps were rarer in used prompts (4% of used vs 17% of unused, PLAYBOOK §15.8), so roll 3-4 takes and reject face artefacts.
This is the default innovation-budget slot: it's cheap, and each tribe is a fresh lottery ticket.

variants.name: Use-case flip
variants.rule: Same body; the hook reframes the use ('for your period cramps', 'for night-shift nurses').
variants.gate: Max 2 use-cases per product per week.

checks.rule: pHash of 0-3 s differs from every prior post on the page

open: Which tribes work for 45-65+ FB audiences is untested.
review: Tier B, not A: the 4 internal winners share the robe body and differ only by recipient line, so they show the body carries new hooks, not that a new TRIBE works on FB. Included because Omar named it and it's the cheapest proven way to buy fresh lottery tickets (1 gen vs 4).
